skillPacks.title: Superpowers Essentials
skillPacks.blurb: Five battle-tested software-development methodology skills from obra/superpowers: brainstorm before building, debug by root cause, write step-by-step plans, take code review with rigor, and prove work is done before claiming it.
skillPacks.blurbZh: obra/superpowers 精选的五条软件开发方法论:动手前先构思、按根因调试、写分步计划、以技术严谨对待评审、宣称完成前先拿证据。

commandPreviews.name: brainstorming
commandPreviews.description: Explore before building: divergent ideas, cross-domain analogies, assumption checks
commandPreviews.descriptionZh: 动手前先构思:发散探索、跨域类比、假设盘点

commandPreviews.name: systematic-debugging
commandPreviews.description: Debug by root cause, not by patching symptoms
commandPreviews.descriptionZh: 按根因调试,不按症状打补丁

commandPreviews.name: writing-plans
commandPreviews.description: Turn a spec into zero-context, bite-sized step-by-step plans
commandPreviews.descriptionZh: 把 spec 拆成零上下文、2-5 分钟粒度的分步计划

commandPreviews.name: receiving-code-review
commandPreviews.description: Treat review feedback with technical rigor — verify before implementing
commandPreviews.descriptionZh: 以技术严谨对待评审意见,先验证再实现

commandPreviews.name: verification-before-completion
commandPreviews.description: Evidence before claims: find the proving command, run it, read the output
commandPreviews.descriptionZh: 宣称完成前先拿证据:找到验证命令、跑、读输出
